steps.en: Send the repo URL to your coding agent and ask it to install the Skill
steps.zh: 把仓库地址发给编码 agent，让它安装 Skill

steps.en: On first use it opens the local gallery so you can browse the numbered styles
steps.zh: 首次使用时打开本地画廊，供你浏览编号风格

steps.en: Pick style, layout and theme-color numbers with a theme — or just the theme
steps.zh: 选风格、图型、主题色编号并给出主题——也可以只给主题
steps.code: 图型：SC-001，风格：041，主题色：C-01，主题：秋天的第一杯奶茶

steps.en: Resolves your image model against its per-style capability matrix
steps.zh: 拿当前生图模型对照逐风格能力矩阵做判定

steps.en: Assembles the bilingual prompt; pads a style-isolation reference image when text can't activate the look
steps.zh: 组装双语提示词；文字激活不了画风时，垫一张带风格隔离指令的编号参考图

steps.en: Paste the prompt into any image AI — or ask the agent to generate on the spot
steps.zh: 把提示词贴进任意生图 AI，或直接让 agent 出图

value.en: One theme sentence becomes a style-faithful hand-drawn image — no art jargon to learn, no style drift between generations
value.zh: 一句主题就能得到画风忠实的成图——不用背画风术语，多次生成也不漂移
